title: Unsafe cryptographic algorithm or parameter selection in a TypeScript runtime
preconditions: request/config values select algorithm, digest, key, IV, or mode
serialized keys/parameters cross a runtime trust boundary
dangerous_transitions: untrusted algorithm/parameter choice reaches a cryptographic primitive
weak mode or reused nonce is accepted by configuration
counterevidence: Algorithm and parameter choices are fixed or allowlisted with validated key/nonce constraints.
verification_recipe: Trace algorithm and parameter sources to the exact Node/WebCrypto primitive.
Check key length, mode, nonce uniqueness, tag verification, and error behavior.
